name: EUR/USD Multi-Level Breakout Analysis
description: Compares breakout behavior at three EUR/USD levels (1.05, 1.10, 1.15) to determine if post-breakout drift is level-specific or a general momentum effect. For each level, detects crossover breakouts, computes 20-day forward returns, and compares event counts, average returns, and hit rates side by side. Includes a combined forward return distribution histogram, price chart with all three reference levels, and clickable event markers per level.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD MULTI-LEVEL BREAKOUT ANALYSIS (1.05 / 1.10 / 1.15)
# =============================================================================
# Tests three breakout levels simultaneously to determine if post-breakout
# drift is level-specific or a general momentum effect.
# Event: EUR/USD daily close crosses above each level from below
# Forward window: 20 trading days
# Output: Cross-level comparison table, combined return histogram,
#         price chart with all reference levels, event markers per level
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# --- Forward Returns (shared across all levels) ---
fwd_20d = ((close << 20) - close) / close

# =============================================================================
# LEVEL 1.05
# =============================================================================
is_breakout_105 = crossover(close, 1.05)
fwd_20d_105 = where(is_breakout_105, fwd_20d)
hit_105 = where(is_breakout_105, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_at_105 = where(is_breakout_105, close)

# =============================================================================
# LEVEL 1.10
# =============================================================================
is_breakout_110 = crossover(close, 1.10)
fwd_20d_110 = where(is_breakout_110, fwd_20d)
hit_110 = where(is_breakout_110, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_at_110 = where(is_breakout_110, close)

# =============================================================================
# LEVEL 1.15
# =============================================================================
is_breakout_115 = crossover(close, 1.15)
fwd_20d_115 = where(is_breakout_115, fwd_20d)
hit_115 = where(is_breakout_115, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
close_at_115 = where(is_breakout_115, close)

# =============================================================================
# COMBINED BREAKOUT RETURNS (for histogram)
# =============================================================================
# Merge sparse series — non-null only on breakout days
# coalesce picks first non-null; overlap is rare (would require gap > 0.10)
fwd_20d_all = coalesce(fwd_20d_105, fwd_20d_110, fwd_20d_115)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Cross-Level Comparison ---
# Rows: metrics, Columns: levels — enables direct side-by-side comparison
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Breakout Comparison: 1.05 vs 1.10 vs 1.15',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=[
            'Breakout Events',
            'Avg +20d Return',
            'Hit Rate (+20d > 0)',
            'Baseline Avg +20d (All Days)'
        ],
        col_headers=['1.05 Level', '1.10 Level', '1.15 Level'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Breakout event counts (Count on sparse series)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Distinct crossover events at 1.05'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Distinct crossover events at 1.10'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Distinct crossover events at 1.15'),
            # Row 1: Average 20d forward return after breakout
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after 1.05 breakout'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after 1.10 breakout'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean 20d fwd return after 1.15 breakout'),
            # Row 2: Hit rate (% of breakouts with positive 20d return)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.05 breakouts followed by positive 20d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.10 breakouts followed by positive 20d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of 1.15 breakouts followed by positive 20d return'),
            # Row 3: Baseline (same for all columns — avg 20d return on any day)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Baseline: avg 20d fwd return across all trading days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Baseline: avg 20d fwd return across all trading days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Baseline: avg 20d fwd return across all trading days')
        ]
    ),
    category='EUR/USD Multi-Level Breakout',
    order=0
)(fwd_20d_105, fwd_20d_110, fwd_20d_115, fwd_20d_105, fwd_20d_110, fwd_20d_115, hit_105, hit_110, hit_115, fwd_20d, fwd_20d, fwd_20d)

# --- Histogram: Combined Distribution of +20d Returns Across All Levels ---
histogram(
    title='Distribution of +20d Returns After Breakout (All Levels Combined)',
    category='EUR/USD Multi-Level Breakout',
    bins=30,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='20-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_20d_all)

# --- Chart: EUR/USD Price with All Three Reference Levels ---
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Close with 1.05 / 1.10 / 1.15 Levels',
    category='EUR/USD Multi-Level Breakout',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.05, title='1.05 Level', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.10, title='1.10 Level', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.15, title='1.15 Level', color=Color.Rose, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=idx, y_values=close)

# --- Event Markers: One Per Level ---
# 1.05 breakouts
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Breakout Above 1.05',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_breakout_105, close_at_105, fwd_20d_105)

# 1.10 breakouts
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Breakout Above 1.10',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_breakout_110, close_at_110, fwd_20d_110)

# 1.15 breakouts
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Breakout Above 1.15',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_breakout_115, close_at_115, fwd_20d_115)
